use_capture_fixture: use the capture pytest fixture to capture and compare stdout output in pybind11 tests
compare_output_with_Output_class: compare captured output against expected strings using the Output class ignoring constructor lines
compare_unordered_output: compare output lines in any order using the Unordered class for non-sequential test assertions
sanitize_docstrings_with_doc_fixture: sanitize pybind11 docstrings using the doc fixture to normalize Python 2 vs 3 differences
sanitize_exception_messages_with_msg_fix: sanitize exception messages using the msg fixture to normalize hexadecimal values and module names
